Striking outsourced rail workers to take battle to Labour Party conference

RAIL union RMT will hold protests outside Labour Party conference meeting in Liverpool on Monday September 28 with striking outsourced rail workers to highlight low pay and calling for them to be taken in-house.

Outsourced RMT members on TransPennine contracts working for Bidvest Noonan and Rail Gourmet are striking against low pay and in-work poverty.

Outsourced workers on another publicly owned contract LNER who work for Gate Solutions will also be taking strike action next month at Doncaster, Edinburgh Waverley, King's Cross, Leeds, Newcastle and York starting with 24-hour action from October 16.

Notes to editors
2. RMT striking outsourced workers protest will take place at 11.30am to 12.00 outside conference on Monday September 28.
3. This will be followed by an Insource Now! Rally with RMT, UNISON and PCS at 1pm at the Hilton Hotel, 3 Thomas Steers Way, Liverpool, L1 8LW.
4. Speakers included RMT general secretary Eddie Dempsey, UNISON general secretary Andrea Egan, PCS general secretary Fran Heathcote, Andy McDonald MP, TUC general secretary Paul Nowak and chair, Kim Johnson MP.
